action: Read the CSV export handler source (not driven).
expected: The export reliably starts a download in every supported browser and states a failure when it cannot.
observed: exportCsv builds the Blob, creates a detached <a>, sets href/download, calls a.click() and then calls URL.revokeObjectURL(url) in the same synchronous tick; the anchor is never appended to the document. This is the classic pattern that silently no-ops in Firefox (and some Safari builds) because the object URL is revoked before the browser commits the download. A judge/recommendation: correct in Chromium, fragile elsewhere. Suggest appendChild + revoke in a timeout/after the download event, and a stated failure if nothing starts.
repro: 1. Open /settings/audit. 2. Click 'Export CSV of shown rows'. 3. In Firefox, observe no file arrives and no error is stated.
evidence: src/routes/settings/audit.tsx:81-112 (createObjectURL → a.click() → revokeObjectURL; no body.appendChild)

action: Loaded /, then counted every element carrying aria-current="page".
